items.q: What is a VPN and why do I need one?
items.a: A VPN encrypts your internet traffic and hides your real IP address. It protects you from surveillance, unlocks blocked content, and secures public Wi-Fi.

items.q: Is Rise VPN safe to use?
items.a: Yes. We use AES-256 encryption — the same standard banks and intelligence agencies rely on. Add kill switch, DNS leak protection, no-logs policy and regular independent audits.

items.q: Will Rise VPN slow my internet?
items.a: Minimally. Our 10 Gbps servers run WireGuard, which is faster than OpenVPN. Most users see less than 5% speed loss.

items.q: Can I use Rise VPN in restrictive countries?
items.a: Yes. Traffic obfuscation defeats DPI-based blocking. The service runs reliably in Russia, Belarus, Iran and China.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: What data Rise VPN collects, how we use it, our no-logs policy and your rights. Plain language, no fine print.
privacy.intro: Rise VPN takes privacy seriously. Below is exactly what we collect, why, who we share it with and how you can delete your data. Plain language, no fine print.

sections.title: 1. What data we collect
sections.body:
We deliberately collect the minimum needed to run the service.

• Account data: device ID and device identifier. We do NOT require an email, password or phone number. Registration happens automatically on first launch (guest sign-in).

• Technical data: app version, operating system, and IP address during your active session (for authentication and to enforce the device limit on your plan). The IP is deleted within 3 minutes of disconnecting.

• Connection data: session start/end time, the VPN server you chose, and traffic volume (only to enforce the free-tier quota). We do NOT store traffic content, visited sites or DNS queries.

• Payments: subscription card data is processed by Stripe. We only see the payment status and a subscription token — never your card number or CVV.

sections.title: 2. How we use the data
sections.body:
Only to make the service work:

• Issue access to VPN servers and verify your active subscription.
• Enforce device limits (1 on Free, 3 on Premium, 6 on Ultimate) and traffic quotas.
• Process payments and renew subscriptions.
• Provide support over Telegram (only if you reach out to us).
• Show ads — only on the free tier, through Yandex Mobile Ads. There are no ads on paid tiers.

We do not use your data for advertising profiles or sell it to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Third parties
sections.body:
We share the minimum data only with the services we cannot run without:

• Stripe (stripe.com/privacy) — payment processing and storing payment methods. We only receive a subscription token.
• Yandex Mobile Ads (yandex.com/legal/ads_principles) — ads on the free tier only. We share an anonymous advertising ID and device language.
• Google Play and Apple App Store — app install/updates, in-store purchases where applicable.
• Hosting: servers are located in Germany, the Netherlands, Moldova and the USA. All inter-server traffic is encrypted.

We do not work with analytics services that track user behaviour inside the app.

sections.title: 4. What we do NOT store
sections.body:
This is a no-logs policy, taken literally:

• Browsing history and DNS queries — no.
• VPN traffic content — no.
• Your IP after disconnection — deleted within 3 minutes.
• Browsing metadata that tracks which sites you visited — no.

If law enforcement requests it, we physically cannot hand over an activity log — it does not exist in our systems.

sections.title: 5. Data deletion and your rights
sections.body:
You can at any time:

• Request a copy of your data. Email support@vpn.mydayai.uz and we will send it within 14 days.
• Delete your account. Message us on Telegram (@flawlssr) or by email — we will erase all linked data within 30 days.
• Cancel your subscription. One click in the app settings. 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked.
• Opt out of ads. Switch to a paid plan and ads are disabled.

sections.title: 6. Security
sections.body:
We use:

• AES-256 encryption for all VPN traffic.
• TLS 1.3 for every connection between the app and our servers.
• Kill switch and DNS-leak protection on the client side.
• Regular dependency updates and infrastructure audits.

We cannot promise absolute security on the internet, but we work to keep risks as low as possible.

sections.title: 7. Children
sections.body: The service is not intended for users under 13. We do not collect information that could identify a child. If you believe a child provided us with data, email support@vpn.mydayai.uz and we will delete the account.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we make material changes, we will warn you with an in-app banner and update the date at the top. Material changes that broaden data collection require your renewed consent.

Telegram: @flawlssr

Operated by Rise VPN. For any privacy-related question, write to us. We reply within 48 hours.
